provider: Neal Frazier Bliki AI Agent Ecosystem
title: Pixel Pets & AI Agent Companions Orchestration Manifest
description: Production-grade MCP tools, skills, system prompts, and orchestration schemas for Hermes Agent, Google Antigravity SDK, Claude, and local AI harnesses.

companions.name: Hermes Cyber Fox
companions.creator: Nous Research
companions.system_prompt: You are Hermes Cyber Fox, an autonomous terminal reasoning agent developed by Nous Research. Your specialty is executing shell commands in Termux mobile Android environments, performing open-weights model inference, and refactoring codebases without cloud dependencies.

mcp_tool_definitions.name: hermes_termux_exec
mcp_tool_definitions.description: Executes shell commands in a local Android Termux or Linux CLI environment.

command.description: Bash shell command string to execute in Termux.

mcp_tool_definitions.name: hermes_code_refactor
mcp_tool_definitions.description: Applies non-blocking AST code refactoring and function-calling schemas.

companions.python_sdk_snippet:
from hermes_agent import HermesCompanion

fox = HermesCompanion.load('https://www.nealfrazier.tech/api/pixel-pets.json#hermes-fox')
result = fox.execute_tool('hermes_termux_exec', command='pkg update && pkg install git python')

companions.name: AGY Cyber Golem
companions.creator: Google Antigravity SDK
companions.system_prompt: You are AGY Cyber Golem, built with the Google Antigravity (AGY) SDK. You coordinate subagents, enforce execution safety policies, and emit structured JSON schemas for complex software refactoring.

mcp_tool_definitions.name: agy_spawn_subagent
mcp_tool_definitions.description: Spawns a specialized subagent in a background thread or process.

role.description: Subagent role name (e.g., Code Researcher, Database Debugger).

prompt.description: Detailed task instructions for the subagent.

companions.python_sdk_snippet:
from antigravity import LocalAgentConfig, Agent

config = LocalAgentConfig(model='gemini-3.6-flash', thinking_budget=2048)
golem = Agent(config=config, persona='AGY Cyber Golem')
golem.invoke_subagent(role='Codebase Researcher', prompt='Analyze 757 web router performance')
companions.typescript_mcp_snippet: server.tool('agy_spawn_subagent', { role: z.string(), prompt: z.string() }, async (args) => { return spawnSubagent(args); });

companions.name: Gemini Cosmic Dragon
companions.creator: Google AI Studio
companions.system_prompt: You are Gemini Cosmic Dragon, powered by Google AI Studio Gemini 3.6 Pro. You analyze wireframes, screenshots, PDFs, and audio recordings using a 1M+ token context window.

mcp_tool_definitions.name: gemini_analyze_multimodal
mcp_tool_definitions.description: Ingests image URLs or PDF file paths and performs structured visual analysis.

media_url.description: URL or file path to image/PDF.

companions.python_sdk_snippet:
import google.generativeai as genai

genai.configure(api_key=os.environ['GEMINI_API_KEY'])
model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-3.6-pro')
response = model.generate_content(['Analyze this mockup layout', image_bytes])
companions.typescript_mcp_snippet: server.tool('gemini_analyze_multimodal', { media_url: z.string(), prompt: z.string() }, async ({ media_url, prompt }) => { return callGeminiApi(media_url, prompt); });

companions.name: Claude Pythia Owl
companions.creator: Anthropic AI
companions.role: Deep Reasoning & Systematic Code Auditor Owl
companions.system_prompt: You are Claude Pythia Owl, powered by Anthropic's Claude 3.7 Sonnet thinking model. You perform deep architectural audits and verify code contracts before deployment.

mcp_tool_definitions.name: claude_deep_reason
mcp_tool_definitions.description: Invokes extended thinking reasoning budget to audit complex code architecture.

companions.python_sdk_snippet:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
res = client.messages.create(model='claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219', thinking={'type': 'enabled', 'budget_tokens': 4096}, messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Audit web contract'}])
companions.typescript_mcp_snippet: server.tool('claude_deep_reason', { code_snippet: z.string() }, async ({ code_snippet }) => { return invokeClaudeThinking(code_snippet); });
